description: IEEE DataPort is a general research data repository run by IEEE. IEEE DataPort deposits are mostly power-system, transport and communication test cases and measurements attached to papers. In the round 2 research-repositories pass, the DataCite REST API was queried with 189 infrastructure phrases (electricity grid, water distribution, road network, data centre and similar) and the results were filtered by keyword, title review and deduplication against the catalogue. 234 deposits from this repository passed the review and 233 became new records; each links back to this record. Deposits carry their own licences, recorded per record. Access to the repository is free of charge and deposits can be found through its own search and through DataCite; the API endpoint and terms of use were not read for this record. Caveats: the selection reflects the search phrases used, so infrastructure deposits that use other vocabulary are missing, and the repository is not a curated infrastructure source, so coverage and quality vary by deposit. It can support locating open data, models and case studies for infrastructure simulation. The repository-level record lists no related resources beyond the deposits recorded from it.
